tooltips.roi: Return on Investment: (Total Cashes − Total Buy-ins) / Total Buy-ins.
tooltips.itm: In-The-Money %: Percentage of tournaments played where you cashed.
tooltips.variance: Tracks cumulative peak-to-trough swings across your MTT grind.
tooltips.platforms: Breakdown of volume and net profit across your poker rooms.
tooltips.activeGoals: Goals automatically update whenever you log, edit, or delete sessions and transactions.
tooltips.quickSync: Enter your current live poker room balances to automatically log the exact net difference.
tooltips.socialFeed: Public posts are visible to the community. Your exact bankroll balances are ALWAYS private.
tooltips.cumulativeProfit: Cumulative Net Profit from your logged MTT sessions in the selected time window (starts at 0).
tooltips.bankrollHistory: Playable Bankroll curve reconstructed from all poker room deposits, withdrawals, transfers, and session results.
tooltips.rollingRoi: Shows how your cumulative ROI % stabilizes over time alongside each session's Average Buy-In (ABI).
tooltips.roomProfit: Exact net profit/loss per poker room calculated from synced session ledger entries and single-room sessions.
tooltips.grindIntensity: Compares your ROI % across focused (<5 MTT/h), standard (5-8 MTT/h), and mass multi-tabling (8+ MTT/h) sessions.
tooltips.abiDistribution: Distribution of session outcomes normalized in multiples of your Average Buy-In (ABI).
tooltips.totalProfit: Net tournament profit (Total Cashes minus Total Buy-ins).
tooltips.volume: Total number of multi-table tournaments and sessions logged.
tooltips.avgBuyIn: Average Buy-In (ABI): Total Buy-ins divided by Total Tournaments played.
tooltips.hourlyRate: Net profit earned per hour of table time.
tooltips.winRate: Percentage of sessions finished in net profit.
tooltips.biggestWin: Your largest net profit in a single session.
